evidence.name: Screen field: Plan name vs. price width
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Plan name vs. price width" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Plan name vs. price width
sections.description: Sets how much of each plan card's width goes to the left labels (plan name and description), leaving the rest for the right labels (price and billing period). Around 60-70% usually gives names enough room while keeping prices aligned on the right. Lower it if prices look cramped, raise it if plan names wrap awkwardly.
